card.name: Digits inside calendar dates
card.fires_on: A single digit in a date, usually the day number right after a month name (October 7, 2011) or the first digit of a time or numeric date. Strongest in posting dates and biographical dates.

modes.label: Day after month name
modes.description: The day-of-month digit directly after a month name, before the comma and year.

modes.label: Digit within a day or time
modes.description: A digit that is part of a two-digit day, numeric date or clock time.

card.writes: It suppresses all the digit tokens, so the model is steered away from putting another digit next, as in a date that is about to end with a comma or year.
card.plain: It marks a digit within a calendar date, such as the day after a month name.
